overview: Draft on the proposed parallel design: 11 boards allocated by chance, six switching the template package on in February 2027 and five in December 2027, with outcomes compared between groups from March to November 2027.
population: Case discussions at the 11 boards; 20 discussions per board per month sampled by the data manager.
exposure: Template package from February (six boards) or December (five boards).
procedures: Allocation by a computer-generated list stratified by board size; monthly sampling and review of minutes against the seven items; treatment dates from hospital systems; questionnaire to sampled patients.

outcomes.name: Complete decision documentation
outcomes.measure: All seven core items documented in the minutes

outcomes.name: Time to first treatment
outcomes.measure: Days from discussion to first treatment

outcomes.name: Meeting duration
outcomes.measure: Minutes from start to end of each meeting

feasibility: Depends on switching on six boards in February, which the licensing plan does not allow.
biasMitigation: Blinded review of minutes by a reviewer from another hospital

parsimony.simplestPath: Two groups of boards, one primary outcome.

summary: Draft protocol for the proposed parallel design.
